title: Deleted image retention conflict
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

requirements.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-immediate-permanent in unresolved decision DEC-delete-policy: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-immediate-permanent in unresolved decision DEC-delete-policy: After the owner selects Delete for an uploaded image, the selected image is immediately no longer available to the owner, and any subsequent owner attempt to recover that image fails.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-30-day-recoverable in unresolved decision DEC-delete-policy: Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-30-day-recoverable in unresolved decision DEC-delete-policy: After the owner selects Delete for an uploaded image, the owner can recover that same image within the 30 days following Delete.

open_questions: What exact event after Delete starts the 30-day recoverability period for the owner?
Should the 30-day period be measured in elapsed calendar days, a specific time zone or calendar basis, or another basis?
Is the final moment of the 30-day period included in the recoverability window, and exactly when does the window end?
What happens to the deleted image after the 30-day period ends?
How is the owner's Delete selection supplied to the system, and what identifies the uploaded image and the owner in that request?
How does the system communicate deletion success, recoverability, and any inability to recover to the owner?
Which owner-visible outcomes apply under each alternative deletion policy: immediate permanent deletion versus owner recoverability for 30 days after Delete?
Which deletion policy should apply when an uploaded image's owner selects Delete: immediate permanent deletion or owner recoverability for 30 days after Delete?
Who has authority to resolve the conflict between the privacy stakeholder request and the support stakeholder request?
Who is accountable for delivering the selected deleted-image handling behavior?
When must the selected deleted-image handling behavior be delivered?
